entries.title: Romans 2:1
segments: Therefore you have nothing to say in your own defense, whoever you are who set yourself up as a judge. In judging others you condemn yourself, for you who set yourself up as a judge do the very same things.

entries.title: Romans 2:2
segments: And we know that God's judgment falls unerringly upon those who do them.

entries.title: Romans 2:3
segments: You who judge those that do such things and yet are yourself guilty of them-do you suppose that you of all men will escape God's judgement?

entries.title: Romans 2:4
segments: Or do you think lightly of his abundant kindness, patience, and forbearance, not realizing that his kindness is meant to lead you to repentance?

entries.title: Romans 2:5
segments: Hard-hearted and impenitent as you are, you are storing up for yourself Wrath on the 'Day of Wrath,' when God's justice as a judge will be revealed;

entries.title: Romans 2:6
segments: For 'he will give to every man what his actions deserve.'

entries.title: Romans 2:7
segments: To those who, by perseverance in doing good, aim at glory, honor, and all that is imperishable, he will give Immortal Life;

entries.title: Romans 2:8
segments: While as to those who are factious, and disobedient to Truth but obedient to Evil, wrath and anger, distress and despair,

entries.title: Romans 2:9
segments: Will fall upon every human being who persists in wrong-doing- -upon the Jew first, but also upon the Greek.

entries.title: Romans 2:10
segments: But there will be glory, honor, and peace for every one who does right-for the Jew first, but also for the Greek,

entries.title: Romans 2:11
segments: Since God shows no partiality.

entries.title: Romans 2:12
segments: All who, when they sin, are without Law will also perish without Law; while all who, when they sin, are under Law, will be judged as being under Law.

entries.title: Romans 2:13
segments: It is not those who hear the words of a Law that are righteous before God, but it is those who obey it that will be pronounced righteous.

entries.title: Romans 2:14
segments: When Gentiles, who have no Law, do instinctively what the Law requires, they, though they have no Law, are a Law to themselves;

entries.title: Romans 2:15
segments: For they show the demands of the Law written upon their hearts; their consciences corroborating it, while in their thoughts they argue either in self-accusation or, it may be, in self- defense--

entries.title: Romans 2:16
segments: On the day when God passes judgement on men's inmost lives, as the Good News that I tell declares that he will do through Christ Jesus.

entries.title: Romans 2:17
segments: But, perhaps, you bear the name of 'Jew,' and are relying upon Law, and boast of belonging to God, and understand his will,

entries.title: Romans 2:18
segments: And, having been carefully instructed from the Law, have learned to appreciate the finer moral distinctions.

entries.title: Romans 2:19
segments: Perhaps you are confident that you are a guide to the blind, a light to those who are in the dark, an instructor of the unintelligent,

entries.title: Romans 2:20
segments: And a teacher of the childish, because in the Law you possess the outline of all Knowledge and Truth.

entries.title: Romans 2:21
segments: Why, then, you teacher of others, do not you teach yourself? Do you preach against stealing, and yet steal?

entries.title: Romans 2:22
segments: Do you forbid adultery, and yet commit adultery? Do you loathe idols, and yet plunder temples?

entries.title: Romans 2:23
segments: Boasting, as you do, of your Law, do you dishonor God by breaking the Law?

entries.title: Romans 2:24
segments: For, as Scripture says-'The name of God is reviled among the Gentiles because of you'!

entries.title: Romans 2:25
segments: Circumcision has its value, if you are obeying the Law. But, if you are a breaker of the Law, your circumcision is no better than uncircumcision.

entries.title: Romans 2:26
segments: If, then, an uncircumcised man pays regard to the requirements of the Law, will not he, although not circumcised, be regarded by God as if he were?

entries.title: Romans 2:27
segments: Indeed, the man who, owing to his birth, remains uncircumcised, and yet scrupulously obeys the Law, will condemn you, who, for all your written Law and your circumcision, are yet a breaker of the Law.

entries.title: Romans 2:28
segments: For a man who is only a Jew outwardly is not a real Jew; nor is outward bodily circumcision real circumcision. The real Jew is the man who is a Jew in soul;

entries.title: Romans 2:29
segments: And the real circumcision is the circumcision of the heart, a spiritual and not a literal thing. Such a man wins praise from God, though not from men.
